plan.title: Cancel Create New Version on Closed RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate bidding configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required evaluation reopening configuration.
Verify the RFQ is visibly closed before the action.
Record the visible closed status for comparison after cancelling.
Verify the closed RFQ has the expected vendor response before opening the confirmation.
Record and verify the responding vendor shown by the event data.
Record and verify the existing bid price before the action.
Open the confirmation window for creating a new version.

args.text: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

steps.note: Verify the expected confirmation prompt is shown.
Verify the confirmation offers a Cancel action.
Cancel creation of the new version.

args.text: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

steps.note: Verify the confirmation window closes.
Verify the confirmation controls are no longer visible.
Verify the visible closed status did not change.
Verify the same response remains after cancellation.
Verify the vendor data remains present after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid data remains present after cancellation.
